thread:
oncall-bot: 🚨 PAGE: inference-runtime latency_p95 > 1200ms (5m) — routed to #eng-oncall
alex: I saw 3 pages in the last 10m for p95. Any quick mitigation? seems related to a cluster bump around 12:04 UTC
maria: confirming, latency spike correlated with a spike in request tails to the east region. Could be a noisy model rollout.
samir: logs show steady CPU saturation on node-gpu-12, KV cache misses spiked. I'm checking unevicted caches now.
lina: @samir if that's right we should fall back to the smaller model variant for that region. Can someone flip the routing? :pray:
alex: I'll trigger the routing fallback via deploy-bot. giving a heads-up to customer-impact list.
opsbot: deploy-bot: Rolling back traffic for model "gpt-open-v2-large" -> "gpt-open-v2-small" for region us-east-1 (policy: automatic-fallback). started
maria: nice. also, paging frequency is painful; this alert fired 6 times during the incident (flapping). We need to tune dedup/forgiveness.
samir: agree — current rule: p95 > 1200ms for 5m. It's sensitive to short, bursty tails. Proposing: require 10m or add volume filter.
alex: propose two-step: change alert to p95>1200ms for 10m AND requests_per_minute > 50
jordan: +1. For paging policy: sev1 should page only if customer-impacting or sustained across regions. Otherwise ticket to #eng-sre.
lina: yes — the current alert is severity 1 by default (pages). It triggered pages for single-region transient spikes.
oncall-bot: incident-note: mitigation applied — fallback model routing executed at 1789123469. latency p95 dropped to 540ms within 90s.
maria: thanks — that mitigated customer impact. we should run a post-incident tune: reduce sensitivity, add dedup window, and create a dashboard panel for tail latency + KV cache miss rate.
samir: draft alert rule (promql):

```
alert: InferenceRuntimeHighP95
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, region)) > 1.2
  and sum(rate(requests_total[5m])) by (region) > 0.8333 # ~50rpm
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: "page"
annotations:
  summary: "Inference runtime p95 > 1.2s for 10m and traffic > 50rpm in {{ $labels.region }}"
```

samir: note I'm keeping severity "page" while we refine the rule, but we'll map channel differently.
alex: mapping suggestion: severity=page + multi-region -> #eng-oncall (page); severity=page + single-region -> #eng-sre (ticket only). That reduces noisy pages.
jordan: and add a dedup window in alertmanager config: group_interval: 15m, repeat_interval: 60m for this alert group.
lina: I'll open a follow-up ticket with action items: update rule, update alertmanager grouping, add dashboard, and do a 2-week review after deploy.
oncall-bot: handoff reminder: @alex handing on-call to @maria at 1789124000. Please pick up any residual tasks.
amaria: picked up. I'll own the immediate follow-ups and schedule the tuning PR.
alex: quick note — we should also add a silent early-warning alert (no page) for kv_cache_miss_rate > 0.2 to surface regressing cache behavior.
samir: added to my TODO list. I'll draft the early-warning rule and a Grafana panel with cache miss vs tail latency.
jordan: assigning owners in ticket: samir (alert rule PR), lina (dashboard), alex (routing policy doc), maria (postmortem + rollout), opsbot (deploy change review).
lina: postmortem template draft will include timeline, root-cause hypothesis (model rollout -> cache pressure), and concrete tuning changes.
oncall-bot: incident closed: pages suppressed after fallback. Final note: customer-impact = low (no widespread errors, brief latency increase). Logged at 1789125678.
alex: thanks everyone — good quick coordination. We'll aim to have PRs up by EOD and patch alertmanager config in next maintenance window. :thumbsup:
maria: adding retrospective blurb to the weekly on-call sync. Also can we have an automated runbook step to check KV cache utilization before paging? that might cut noise.
samir: good idea — I'll add a playbook snip. Example command to check cache evictions:

```
# check kv cache evictions across region
sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[1m])) by (region)
```

alex: ok locking this thread — follow-ups in ticket INF-4321.
